condition: dayjs() parses an ISO-like string with an out-of-range month or day (e.g. '2025-13-36T14:19:39') leniently and rolls it over, so isValid() returns true.
workaround: Use the customParseFormat plugin and parse in strict mode with an explicit format: dayjs(str, 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss', true).isValid().
